query: The recruiting tool's training data was examined for possible biases that could lead to discrimination against applicants of one gender.
The vendor of the CV screening model took measures to detect, prevent and mitigate the biases it identified.
The data sets used to train the candidate-ranking model are relevant, representative and as free of errors as possible.
The screening system is transparent enough for the HR team to interpret why a candidate was rejected and use the output appropriately.
The hiring model reaches an appropriate level of accuracy and robustness and performs consistently across its lifecycle.
The shortlisting system is resilient to errors and stops biased outputs from feeding back into future training data.
An AI system used to analyse and filter job applications and evaluate candidates is classified as high-risk.
Software that decides on promotion or termination of workers or monitors their performance is a high-risk use.
Before using the AI recruiting tool at the workplace, the employer must inform workers' representatives and affected workers.
Placing targeted job advertisements with an AI system falls within the high-risk recruitment category.
